name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
description: The Ghirapur Grand Prix is a death-defying interplanar circuit race, begun as an illegal street race on Avishkar, whose champion wins the Aetherspark.

summary.text: The Ghirapur Grand Prix is a death-defying interplanar circuit race, begun as an illegal street race on Avishkar, whose champion wins the Aetherspark.

citations.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Chandra Nalaar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The chaotic inaugural Grand Prix, the first multiplanar race, crossed nearly two dozen planes, some teams were killed or lost, and Kylem's Cloudspire Racing Team won.

citations.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The Avishkar Assembly then expanded the event beyond Avishkar to invite teams from many planes as an annual festival.

citations.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Second Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The second Grand Prix was held around 4564 AR across Amonkhet and Muraganda with the Aetherspark as grand prize, and Gonti fired the signal flare to start it.

citations.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Second Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

bio.text: The race crossed Amonkhet and Muraganda, where racers were hindered by giant dinosaurs and Saurid raiders, before returning to Ghirapur.

citations.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Second Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: All teams reached the final stage despite hazards and a dragonstorm, but a revanchist coup by former Consulate members trapped many racers, and the coup failed and Mohar was jailed.

citations.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Second Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Mohar Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Zahur crossed the finish line first, winning the Aetherspark.

citations.text: "Basri Ket", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: The second Grand Prix has ended, with Zahur winning the Aetherspark, and the Avishkar Assembly plans to keep the race going as a festival.

citations.text: "Basri Ket", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A stable Omenpath from Amonkhet opens, making Muraganda's wilds part of the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: a stable Omenpath from Amonkhet opened up on Muraganda

citation.text: "Muraganda", section "Second Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A radio report announces the Grand Prix winner will claim the Aetherspark.
timeline.quote: The winner of the Ghirapur Grand Prix gets to claim this once-in-a-lifetime chance at ultimate power and freedom.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Gonti fires the signal flare to start the Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: Gonti fires the flare.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri leads the Amonkheti delegation in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix with Zahur; Zahur crosses the finish line first, winning the Aetherspark.
timeline.quote: Zahur would be the first to cross the finish line, winning the Aetherspark for the team.

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra joins the reigning champions, the Cloudspire Racing Team, in the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: Chandra chose to join the reigning champions, the Cloudspire Racing Team

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Daretti bankrolls the Goblin Rocketeers in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix hoping to find new interplanar travel.
timeline.quote: He bankrolled the team in the hopes of discovering a new means of interplanar travel after the loss of his spark.

citation.text: "Daretti", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The chaotic inaugural Grand Prix, the first multiplanar race, crosses nearly two dozen planes; some teams are killed or lost, and Kylem's Cloudspire Racing Team wins.
timeline.quote: Kylem's team, the Cloudspire Racing Team , won this edition.

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Avishkar Assembly expands the event beyond Avishkar to invite teams from many planes as an annual festival.
timeline.quote: the Avishkar Assembly sought to expand the event beyond the borders of Ghirapur and Avishkar itself

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Second Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The second interplanar Grand Prix is held around 4564 AR across Amonkhet and Muraganda with the Aetherspark as grand prize.
timeline.quote: The Aetherspark , an artifact that contained a planeswalker's spark , was offered as the race's grand prize.

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Second Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The race crosses Amonkhet and Muraganda, where racers are hindered by giant dinosaurs and Saurid raiders, before returning to Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: Their progress was also hindered by attacks from giant dinosaur and Saurid raiders.

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Second Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: All teams reach the final stage despite hazards and a dragonstorm, but a revanchist coup by former Consulate members traps many racers.
timeline.quote: a revanchist coup launched by former Consulate members impeded many of the racers.

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Second Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Speedbrood racing team led by Radian Aatchik competes in the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: A Speedbrood racing team led by Radian Aatchik competed in the Ghirapur Grand Prix across Avishkar , Amonkhet and Muraganda .

citation.text: "Insect", section "Unknown plane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth chooses Winter as co-captain of Duskmourn's racing team for the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: Winter was chosen by Valgavoth as the living representative and co-captain

citation.text: "Winter", section "2nd Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The plane is united under the new Avishkar Assembly, which plans to resurrect the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: The plane is now united under a new planar government called the Avishkar Assembly

citation.text: "Avishkar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Far Fortune's gang is stranded on Avishkar and enters the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: they were stranded on Avishkar and quickly found their way into the Ghirapur Grand Prix

citation.text: "Endriders", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Rocketeers abandon their exploration mission and, funded by Daretti, mount a campaign to win the Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: They abandoned their initial mission of exploration beyond the velocity limit.

citation.text: "Goblin Rocketeers", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mendicant encounters the Grand Prix and decides to use it to transit Omenpaths and return home.
timeline.quote: Under Mendicant's guidance, they deemed the infrastructure of the race to be a perfect iterative field

citation.text: "Guidelight Voyagers", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mohar recruits Harshad and Rudra to trap the racers at the finish line and retake Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: The plan was to lay a trap for the racers at the finish line and retake Kaladesh while everybody was watching.

citation.text: "Mohar Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The trap stops the leading teams and reveals Sita as captain; the coup fails and Mohar is jailed.
timeline.quote: it failed, and Mohar was sent to jail.

citation.text: "Mohar Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The fourth stage of the Ghirapur Grand Prix passed through the Broken Lands, where signs of the Chitin Court's approach appeared.
timeline.quote: The fourth stage of the seconds Ghirapur Grand Prix takes the racers through the Broken Lands.

citation.text: "Ramunap", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sita and Pia Nalaar co-lead the Aether Rangers in the Ghirapur Grand Prix; Sita and Chandra find mutual respect.
timeline.quote: They later found mutual respect after realizing that they were much alike

citation.text: "Sita Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A coup by her father stops Sita near the finish and reveals her identity.
timeline.quote: she was stopped by a sudden coup started by her father, which caused her identity to be revealed

citation.text: "Sita Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sita rescues Chandra and Pia from Jace Beleren but all three are knocked unconscious; Nissa Revane rescues them and Elspeth Tirel heals them.
timeline.quote: all three were rendered unconscious by the mind mage, only being rescued by Nissa Revane and healed by Elspeth Tirel

citation.text: "Sita Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: The independent governing body is overseen by him.
relations.quote: The Grand Prix is managed by an independent governing body overseen by the new night minister of Ghirapur, Gonti .
